Implement **Phase 7** as specified in `docs/Vinea_ERP_Master_Plan_v5.md` §5 (P7), §2 (Compliance architecture — the facts in 2.1, the adapter pattern in 2.2, the tax-engine rules in 2.3), ADR-05 (`FxRevalued` is the last kernel-side stub this phase retires), ADR-10 (the durable outbox), §6 item 4 (tax report totals == Σ journal tax dimensions) and Appendix C.2 ("fiscalization status/queue screens (P7)") — and the RRA documents pinned in the repository under `docs/rra/` (see *Documents this phase is written to*). Rule 12 of `.github/copilot-instructions.md` already says how: through the `FiscalizationAdapter` interface and a durable outbox, with no country logic outside the adapter.

Fiscalization adds **no ledger and no second truth**. The journal is what happened; the fiscal receipt is RRA's record of it; the outbox is the bridge between the two, and it exists so that nothing posted is ever lost and nothing unposted is ever sent. A document is fiscalized because it was posted, in the same database transaction, by a row in `fiscal_outbox` — never by a call made from a request handler. The VAT return is a query over `journal_lines` and nothing else, and it ties to the VAT accounts by construction. If you find yourself computing tax for a payload from anything but the posted lines, or writing a fiscal fact somewhere the outbox cannot see it, stop — the ledger is the truth and the receipt is derived from it.

Two mandatory **STOP for owner approval** gates: after step 2 and after step 5. Report and wait for an explicit go-ahead. Never continue past a report on a "Continue to iterate?" prompt. Every step starts from a pulled `main` on its own branch (`p7-step-N`); once a step is approved, the next may branch from that approved head and rebase onto `main` before its PR (the merge rhythm adopted at P6 step 7). PR titles `feat(fiscal): P7 step N — …`; the owner arms auto-merge; the agent merges nothing. Every step report ends with `git status --short` and `git log @{u}..` both empty, quoted, and `git diff --stat` before any "N passed" claim. Gate steps (2, 5, 9) add their row to `docs/approvals.md` in the same PR — not after the fact.

Where the plan leaves a choice open, decide, implement, and list it under "Decisions worth review" in that step's report, as P1–P6 did.

## Preconditions (already built — consume, never re-implement)

- **Ledger kernel (P2):** PostingEngine is the only GL writer. Signed lines with `branch_id`, `project_id`, `currency_id`, `exchange_rate`, `amount`, `base_amount`, `tax_code_id`, `tax_amount`, `partner_type/partner_id`, `item_id`, `source_doc_type/id`, `source_line_id`. **The tax shape the VAT return reads:** on every taxed line the *base* line (revenue, expense, asset) carries `tax_code_id` and the `tax_amount` it attracted (signed, transaction currency), and the *tax-account* line carries the same `tax_code_id` with `tax_amount = 0` — see `_cashbook_specs` in `app/kernel/posting.py` and the partner-document specs in `app/subledger/documents.py`. Exempt and zero-rated lines carry a code and no tax line. `tax_codes`: `code`, `name`, `nature` (`output | input | exempt | zero_rated`), `rate_pct`, `gl_account_id`, `valid_from/valid_to`; `resolve_tax_code()` enforces the window; `split_tax()` in `app/kernel/money.py` computes inclusive tax as `gross × r/(100+r)` and exclusive as `net × r/100`, half-up to `currency.decimal_places` (RWF = 0). Dated `exchange_rates`; `period_balances` per account × period × branch × currency; `assert_ledger_invariants`; gapless `document_sequences` with `SEQUENCE_CLAIMANTS` in `app/kernel/sequences.py` (branch-scoped sequences exist — `claim_number(..., branch_id=)` uses a branch-level row when one exists); `posting.module_reversal(module)`; `PeriodClosed`/year-end. `FxRevalued` (doc type `FXR`) is still a `_StubEvent` in `app/kernel/events.py`.

## Out of scope — do not build

POS receipts, tills, and the offline till queue (P11 — the adapter, outbox and receipt layout are built so P11 reuses them; nothing till-shaped lands here); Kenya eTIMS, Uganda EFRIS, Tanzania VFD (the Protocol is the boundary; only `NullAdapter` and the Rwanda adapter exist); proforma and training receipts (PS/TS/TR — there is no proforma document, P6 kept quotations out); item composition (`/items/saveItemComposition`, BOM — P12); branch user accounts and insurance (`/branches/saveBrancheUsers`, `/branches/saveBrancheInsurances` — pharmacy); the RRA notice board beyond fetching and listing it; foreign-currency **bank and cash** revaluation (P8 owns bank accounts — decision 13 revalues partner open items only); VAT return e-filing to RRA (the return is produced, filed in Vinea and exported; submission on e-tax is the accountant's act); withholding tax, excise, PAYE; a second job framework (arq/Celery on Redis — decision 4 says what drains the outbox and why Redis stays unused); moving the statement PDF jobs off `run_job`; amended returns as a document type (late entries flow into the next return — decision 12); any change to the P4 tax engine or the P2 rounding rule to suit the payload (decision 6 says where a mismatch goes).

## Decisions locked for this phase — implement exactly

1. **The adapter boundary.** Package `app/fiscal/`: `protocol.py` with `FiscalizationAdapter` (the §2.2 Protocol, grown to what Rwanda needs: `initialize_device`, `sync_codes`, `sync_item_classes`, `lookup_tin`, `register_item`, `fiscalize_sale`, `fiscalize_refund`, `register_purchase`, `fetch_purchase_feed`, `confirm_purchase`, `report_stock_io`, `report_stock_master`, `fetch_imports`, `update_import`); `mapping.py` building **country-neutral** DTOs (`FiscalSale`, `FiscalRefund`, `FiscalPurchase`, `FiscalStockIO`, `FiscalItem`) from Vinea documents; `null.py` — `NullAdapter`, every call a recorded no-op (dev default, non-fiscalized tenants); `rwanda/` — `adapter.py` (`RwandaEbmAdapter`), `routes.py` (**two route profiles** in one table, `vsdc` = the v1.0.5 paths and `osdc` = the v1.0.1 paths, selected per device by `fiscal_devices.profile`; the payload vocabulary is shared, `cmcKey` is added on the `osdc` profile only, and `normalize_receipt()` maps both sales-response shapes — `rcptNo/vsdcRcptPbctDate/sdcId/mrcNo` and `curRcptNo/sdcDateTime` — onto one `FiscalReceipt`), `codes.py` (the §4 code tables as enums seeded from the pinned document and refreshed by `sync_codes`), `payloads.py` (pydantic models for every request and response, field names exactly as the documents spell them, `NUMBER 18,2` fields serialised as decimals with two places). Transport is `httpx` with a 30 s connect/60 s read timeout; every call is logged with the device, the path, the `resultCd` and the elapsed time — never the body, never a key. No module outside `app/fiscal/` imports `rwanda/`. Which profile RRA certifies for a cloud vendor is the owner's conversation with `cis_sdc_certification@rra.gov.rw`; the code does not decide it.

2. **Devices are per branch, keys are secrets.** `fiscal_devices`: `company_id`, `branch_id` (unique per company — one device per branch), `profile`, `environment` (`test | production`), `base_url`, `tin` (copied from the company at initialization, must equal `companies.tin` — `tin_mismatch`), `bhf_id` (2 chars; the main branch is `00`), `dvc_srl_no` (the device serial the owner registered on MyRRA), `mrc_no`, `sdc_id`, `dvc_id`, `cmc_key`, `intrl_key`, `sign_key` (the three keys **encrypted at rest** with Fernet under `Settings.fiscal_key_secret` — a dev-only default when `app_env == "dev"`, required otherwise; never returned by any endpoint, never logged, stripped from every stored payload/response — one redaction test walks every `fiscal_*` row the tape produced and greps for the key strings), `status` (`pending | active | suspended`), `last_req_dt` watermarks per synced kind (`codes`, `item_classes`, `branches`, `notices`, `purchases`, `imports`, `stock_moves` — the documents' `lastReqDt` discipline: send the last successful watermark, store the new one only after a `000`), `last_success_at`, `last_error`. Initialization calls `initialize_device` and stores what comes back. A company is **fiscalized** when it has at least one `active` device; posting an AR invoice or credit note on a fiscalized company for a branch with no active device is refused `fiscal_device_missing`. Activation requires `companies.tin` and locks `gl_settings.negative_stock_policy` at `block` — switching it to `allow` while any device is active is refused `fiscal_requires_block` (CIS §7.30: no receipt for goods the stock does not hold; P5 already refuses the sale under `block`).

3. **What fiscalizes, and the item-line rule.** On a fiscalized company: an **AR invoice** is a sale (`rcptTyCd S`, label NS) and an **AR credit note** is a refund (`R`, label NR). Settlements, allocations, journal batches (`ARJN` / `APJN` — opening balances and corrections, not sales) and every AP document are not fiscalized as sales; AP invoices and returns are **purchases** (decision 9). Every line of a fiscalized invoice or credit note must carry an `item_id` — `fiscal_item_required` on a GL-only line — because a receipt line is an item with a code and a class (VSDC §3.3.6.1 `itemCd`, `itemClsCd` are required). A kit line goes out as its parent (the revenue line, registered as a finished product); its components do not appear on the receipt and do appear in the stock report (decision 10). A document in a foreign currency is fiscalized in **RWF** from its frozen `base_amount`s (decision 6).

4. **The outbox.** `fiscal_outbox` (the `fiscal_outbox` of the plan's schema sketch): `company_id`, `device_id`, `kind` (`item | sale | refund | purchase | purchase_confirm | stock_io | stock_master | import_update`), `source_doc_type`, `source_doc_id`, `sequence_no` (per device, from the row id — FIFO order), `invc_no` / `sar_no` where the kind claims one (decision 5), `payload` JSONB (frozen at enqueue — a retry resends the same bytes), `status` (`queued | sending | sent | failed | unknown | needs_receipt | cancelled`), `attempts`, `next_attempt_at`, `last_result_cd`, `last_error`, `response` JSONB, `sent_at`, `resolved_by`, `resolution_note`. **Written in the same transaction as the thing it reports** — `post_document()` inserts the `sale`/`refund` row before it returns, the stock service inserts `stock_io` + `stock_master` rows beside the moves, item registration inserts `item` on create/change; `assert_fiscal_invariants` proves a posted fiscal document has exactly one `sale`/`refund` row and a row has exactly one document. **Per-device FIFO, one in flight**: the drainer takes the device's oldest non-terminal row under `SELECT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, sends it, records the outcome, and takes the next; a `failed`, `unknown` or `needs_receipt` row **blocks the device's queue** behind it (VSDC: the stock report must follow the sale that caused it, and receipt counters are a sequence — sending out of order is worse than waiting). Transport and `894`-class errors → `queued` with backoff 1 → 5 → 15 → 60 → 360 minutes then every 6 h, forever; a `9xx` server refusal (881–884, 9xx) → `failed` with the code and message, no retry; a response that never arrived (timeout after the request left) → `unknown`, no automatic retry (RRA may hold the sale; a resend would be a duplicate and `994` returns no receipt data). The queue screen offers, under `fiscal:queue_manage`: **Retry now**, **Verify with device** (re-runs `initialize_device` and reads `lastSaleInvcNo` / `lastPchsInvcNo` / `lastSaleRcptNo`: a counter below ours means RRA never saw the row → back to `queued`; at or above → `needs_receipt`), **Attach receipt manually** (the fields of the receipt as read from MyRRA, audited with the actor's note — `needs_receipt` → `sent`), and **Cancel** (only through decision 7's reversal path — a queue row is never cancelled while its document stands). **What drains it:** `app/fiscal/worker.py` — a plain loop process (`python -m app.fiscal.worker`, a `worker` service in `docker-compose.yml` and the e2e stack) that every 15 s lists devices with due rows under `platform_scope()` (add the module to `SANCTIONED_CALLERS`, reviewed like the other four), then drains each device on its own tenant-scoped session with `set_tenant`; plus an after-response kick from the endpoints that enqueue (the `run_job` pattern, for latency); plus `POST /fiscal/outbox/drain` (`by design` in `NO_UI` — the scheduler's hook, as `jobs/sweep` is). Postgres is the queue; Redis stays where P0 left it and the report says so. A device with a queued row older than 24 h is flagged `offline` on the dashboard (VSDC §2.2 item 4: the VSDC stops issuing after 24 h without connectivity).

5. **Receipts, counters, numbers.** `fiscal_receipts`, one per fiscalized document, immutable (trigger, the P2 way): `document_id`, `device_id`, `outbox_id`, `receipt_type` (`NS | NR`), `invc_no`, `org_invc_no`, `rcpt_no` (`rcptNo` / `curRcptNo` — the counter per receipt type), `tot_rcpt_no`, `intrl_data`, `rcpt_sign`, `sdc_id`, `mrc_no`, `sdc_datetime` (`vsdcRcptPbctDate` / `sdcDateTime`), `qr_payload`, `request` and `response` JSONB, `copy_count`; `partner_documents.fiscal_receipt_id`. Counters are proven, not trusted: per device, `rcpt_no` strictly increases within a type and `tot_rcpt_no` across types, in `assert_fiscal_invariants`. **Numbering** through `document_sequences`, claimed in the posting transaction so a queue cannot reorder them: `FIS` (`invcNo` per branch — the CIS invoice number RRA keys the sale by; claimant `fiscal_outbox` rows of kind `sale`/`refund`), `FIP` (`invcNo` for purchases, kinds `purchase`/`purchase_confirm`), `FSAR` (`sarNo` for stock in/out, kind `stock_io`), `FITM` (the 7-digit item-code sequence, claimant `fiscal_items`), `FZR` (Z-report numbers per device, claimant `fiscal_daily_reports`); device activation creates the branch-level `document_sequences` rows for `FIS`, `FIP`, `FSAR` and `FZR` (`claim_number` falls back to the company-wide row when none exists, and a device's counters must never share a run with another branch's); the gapless checker learns to count an integer column (`SequenceClaimant(numeric=True)`, under its own tests) rather than being bypassed. The document's own number (`INV-000123`) prints as the CIS receipt number; `invc_no` is what the payload carries; both are on the receipt.

6. **The payload map.** All amounts in **RWF** (base), two decimals on the wire. Per line: `itemSeq`, `itemCd` and `itemClsCd` from `fiscal_items`, `itemNm` (200), `bcd` (the item's first active barcode or null), `pkgUnitCd` / `qtyUnitCd` (decision 8), `pkg` = `qty`, `qty` = the keyed quantity in the line's UoM, `taxTyCd` from the tax code's `fiscal_tax_type`, `prc` = the **VAT-inclusive** unit price at two decimals (converted from an exclusive document: `unit_price × (100 + r)/100`; taken as keyed on an inclusive one), `splyAmt = qty × prc`, `dcRt` = `discount_percent`, `taxblAmt` = the line's posted **gross** in base, `taxAmt` = the line's posted tax in base, `totAmt = taxblAmt`, and `dcAmt = splyAmt − taxblAmt` — the discount field takes the residue between the wire price and the posted line, because it is the one field the documents do not derive from another. Header buckets A/B/C/D are Σ of the lines by class; `totItemCnt`, `totTaxblAmt`, `totTaxAmt`, `totAmt` are Σ of the buckets; `taxRtA–D` are the programmed rates (0/18/0/0). `custTin` = partner TIN, `custNm` = partner name (60), `custMblNo` = partner phone, `prcOrdCd` = `partner_documents.purchase_code` (decision 7), `pmtTyCd` from `partner_documents.payment_method`, `salesTyCd N` always (v1.0.5: "send only N"), `salesSttsCd 02`, `cfmDt` = the entry's `posted_at` in `Africa/Kigali` as `yyyyMMddhhmmss`, `salesDt` = `document_date`, `stockRlsDt` = `cfmDt` when any line is a stock item, `regrId/regrNm/modrId/modrNm` = the actor's id and name truncated to 20/60, `receipt.rptNo` = the device's next Z number, `receipt.trdeNm/adrs` = branch name and address, `prchrAcptcYn N`, `remark` = the document description (400). A property test over random documents at a 0-dp and a 2-dp base asserts: Σ items == every header bucket; `taxAmt == round(taxblAmt × r/(100+r))` at the base's decimals for every line (it holds by construction — `split_tax` computes inclusive tax the same way, and an exclusive line's tax cannot cross a rounding boundary the inclusive recomputation would not); and reports the census of non-zero `dcAmt` on undiscounted lines (the residue from `prc` at two decimals on a 0-dp base). **Sandbox questions, carried to step 5:** whether RRA tolerates that residue, and whether a refund is sent with positive amounts under `rcptTyCd R` (as built) or negative ones — the ledger and the P2 rounding rule do not change either way; a payload rule changes in `mapping.py`.

7. **Customer, purchase code, payment method, refunds.** `partner_documents` gains `payment_method` (enum `cash | credit | cash_credit | bank_cheque | card | mobile_money | other` → `pmtTyCd 01–07`; defaults `credit` for an invoice with payment terms, `cash` otherwise; on both roles), `purchase_code` (6 chars, nullable), `refund_of_document_id` (nullable). On a fiscalized company an AR invoice to a partner **with a TIN** requires `purchase_code` (`purchase_code_required`, v1.0.5: mandatory for business customers, `881`–`883` otherwise); a credit note must resolve to **one** original fiscalized invoice — from its lines' `returns_line_id`s (all one document, else `refund_spans_invoices`) or from `refund_of_document_id` when no line carries one (`refund_original_required`) — and cumulative refunded quantity per original line may not exceed the invoiced quantity (`refund_exceeds_original`; CIS §7.17). `orgInvcNo` = the original's `invc_no`; `rfdRsnCd` = a required refund reason on the credit note (the §4.16 codes 01–13, `refund_reason` column). **Reversals:** reversing a fiscalized invoice whose sale is `sent` queues a full refund (label NR) with the reversal dialog's reason code; reversing a credit note whose refund is `sent` is refused `fiscal_refund_irreversible` (a refund of a refund is not in the vocabulary — correct by a new invoice); reversing either document while its row is `queued` or `failed` marks the row `cancelled` (RRA never held it) and posts the ordinary P4 reversal — so a `failed` sale is corrected by reversing and re-posting, never by editing; a document whose row is `unknown` or `needs_receipt` cannot be reversed until the row is resolved (`fiscal_status_unresolved` — RRA may hold the sale, and a cancelled row would leave it unrefunded). `TIN lookup` (`/customers/selectCustomer`) is a synchronous read offered from the Customers screen ("Verify TIN"), not a queue row.

8. **Items.** `fiscal_items` (one per item per company): `item_cd` (§4.17: origin + product type + packaging unit + quantity unit + 7-digit `FITM` sequence — the quantity-unit segment left-padded with `X` the way the documents' own samples do, `RW1NTXU0000006`; the sandbox run settles the padding width), `item_cls_cd`, `item_ty_cd`, `orgn_nat_cd`, `pkg_unit_cd`, `qty_unit_cd`, `tax_ty_cd`, `dft_prc` (selling price inclusive, base), `bcd`, `registered_at`, `last_payload_hash`. Sources: `items.fiscal_class_code` (new, nullable — chosen on the Item screen from `fiscal_item_classes`, the synced §3.3.2.2 table; required on a fiscalized company for any item that is sold: `fiscal_class_missing` at post), `items.fiscal_origin_country` (default `RW`), `items.fiscal_package_unit` (default `NT`), `items.fiscal_item_type` (`1 raw material | 2 finished product | 3 service` — stock defaults to 2, service and non-stock to 3, editable), `uoms.fiscal_quantity_unit` (the §4.6 code; required for any UoM that appears on a fiscalized line — `fiscal_uom_unmapped`), `tax_codes.fiscal_tax_type` (`A | B | C | D`; seeded: `VAT-OUT-18 → B`, `VAT-EXEMPT → A`, `VAT-ZERO → C`, input codes `B` for the purchase side; a sale line whose code has none is refused `tax_class_unmapped`). An `item` outbox row is queued on first fiscal use and whenever the registered fields change (hash differs) — it sits in the device FIFO ahead of the sale that needs it, because creation order is queue order. Deactivating an item re-registers it with `useYn N`.

9. **Purchases and imports.** Every posted AP invoice or return on a fiscalized company queues a `purchase` row: `/trnsPurchase/savePurchases` with `regTyCd M`, `pchsTyCd N`, `rcptTyCd P` (invoice) / `R` (return), `pmtTyCd`, `pchsSttsCd 02`, `spplrTin` / `spplrNm` / `spplrInvcNo` (the supplier's reference, numeric when it is), `invcNo` from `FIP`, lines as decision 6 but from the AP side; a line without an item (rent, freight) uses `gl_settings.fiscal_default_purchase_class_code` as `itemClsCd` and the GL account name as `itemNm` (`itemCd` is optional on purchases). **The EBM purchase feed:** `fetch_purchase_feed` pulls `/trnsPurchase/selectTrnsPurchaseSales` by watermark into `fiscal_purchase_feed` (supplier TIN, name, invoice number, buckets, items, `fetched_at`, `decision`, `ap_document_id`); the screen lists undecided rows and lets `fiscal:queue_manage` **Accept** (queues `purchase_confirm`: the same endpoint with `regTyCd A`, `pchsSttsCd 02`, the feed's figures) or **Reject** (`pchsSttsCd 04`), optionally linking a posted AP document; a supplier invoice must never be registered twice — when an AP document is linked to an accepted feed row before its own `purchase` row was sent, that row is `cancelled` in favour of the confirmation (say how in the step-3 report). **Imports:** `fetch_imports` pulls `/imports/selectImportItems` into `fiscal_import_declarations` (task code, declaration number and date, HS code, item name, quantities, supplier, agent, foreign amount/currency/rate, `status`); the screen lets the user pick the Vinea item each line became and **Approve** (`/imports/updateImportItems` with `imptItemSttsCd 3` and the item's `itemCd`/`itemClsCd`) or **Reject** (`4`). Approval is a compliance acknowledgment: it moves no stock (the GRN did) and posts nothing.

10. **Stock reporting.** Every `StockPosting` on a fiscalized company queues one `stock_io` row (`/stock/saveStockItems`, `sarNo` from `FSAR`, `regTyCd M`, `ocrnDt` = move date, items with `qty` in base units, `prc` = the move's `unit_cost`, `splyAmt` = its value, `taxTyCd` from the item's sales code, `taxblAmt` / `taxAmt` per the item's tax class on that value) followed by one `stock_master` row per (item, branch) touched (`/stockMaster/saveStockMaster`, `rsdQty` = on-hand summed over the branch's warehouses at that moment — it is a snapshot, computed when the row is *enqueued*, in the same transaction as the moves). `sarTyCd` by source: AR invoice companion `11`, AR credit note `03`, GRN and unlinked AP invoice `02`, return to supplier `12`, adjustment and count variance `06` (in) / `16` (out), a transfer **between branches** `13` at dispatch and `04` at receipt (a transfer within one branch is invisible to RRA — no row), landed-cost revaluation and every zero-quantity move nothing (no quantity, nothing to report). Stock rows follow their sale in the FIFO by construction (VSDC §3.1: "every stock in/out must have its sales invoice information sent in advance").

11. **The receipt on paper, and the day.** The document detail print layout gains the CIS layout per the 2018 specification §13 (a normal sale) and §14 (a refund): taxpayer name, TIN, branch address, `Client ID:` TIN, lines as `description / unit price × quantity / total / tax label` with the discount line under the item, `TOTAL`, `TOTAL A-EX`, `TOTAL B-18.00%`, `TOTAL C`, `TOTAL TAX B`, `TOTAL TAX` (every rate > 0 always, zero rates only when used — §7.22–7.23), the payment method line, `ITEMS NUMBER`, then the **SDC INFORMATION** block — `Date: dd/mm/yyyy Time: hh:mm:ss` (the SDC's), `SDC ID`, `RECEIPT NUMBER: rcptNo/totRcptNo NS`, `Internal Data` and `Receipt Signature` dashed every four characters — the QR (§7.24.7 format unless a sample receipt says otherwise), then `RECEIPT NUMBER: <document number>`, the CIS date/time (`posted_at`), `MRC`, the RRA logo (§7.29). A refund prints `REFUND` / `REF. NORMAL RECEIPT#: <original tot_rcpt_no>` and negative amounts. **Print is refused until the receipt exists** (`fiscal_receipt_pending` — the button shows the queue status instead; CIS §10). A second print is a **copy**: `COPY` under the header and as a watermark, `THIS IS NOT AN OFFICIAL RECEIPT` below the totals (§11, §15), the same SDC block, `copy_count` incremented and audited; no second call to RRA (v1.0.5 sends `N` only — whether a copy needs a CS counter is a sandbox question for step 5). Non-fiscalized companies keep the P4 layout. **X and Z:** `fiscal_daily_reports` per device — `Z` is a stored close of the day (number from `FZR`, `from_at` = the previous Z or the device's activation, `to_at` = now, the §19.1 content computed from `fiscal_receipts` and their documents: NS count and gross, NR count and gross, taxable and tax per rate split NS/NR, totals by payment method, copies count and gross, items count, discounts), immutable once written; `X` is the same computation from the last Z to now, never stored. Pending queue rows are not receipts: a Z counts what RRA signed, and says how many rows were still queued.

12. **The VAT return.** A query over `journal_lines` for a company and a date range, by tax code: **base** = Σ `base_amount` of lines carrying the code on accounts other than the code's tax account; **tax** = Σ `base_amount` of lines on the code's tax account carrying the code. Sections: sales at the standard rate (base, VAT), zero-rated sales, exempt sales; purchases at the standard rate (base, VAT), imports (the new `VAT-IN-IMP` code), zero-rated and exempt purchases; output VAT, input VAT, **net payable / credit**. Signs follow the ledger (a credit note reduces sales; a return reduces purchases). **The tie:** for each VAT account the report shows the account's movement over the range, the Σ of tagged tax lines, and the difference listed as *untagged movements* line by line (a VAT payment to RRA, a manual journal without a code) — the report is not "balanced", it is *reconciled*, and it says so. **Late entries:** a filed return records `high_water_entry_id` (journal entries are append-only with monotonic ids); a return's lines are those whose entry date is in the range and whose entry id is above every earlier filed return's high-water mark for that date range — so an entry posted into a filed month lands in the **next** return under *Late entries from filed periods* with its date, and the filed figures never change. **Filing** (`tax:vat_return_file`): `vat_returns` (`number` `VATR-` from a new `VAT` run, the range, the figures as filed JSONB, `high_water_entry_id`, `journal_entry_id`, `filed_by/at`, `status posted | reversed`) plus a settlement entry through a new kernel event `VatReturnPosted` (module `tax`, doc type `VAT`): Dr output VAT account / Cr input VAT account for the filed totals, the net to `gl_settings.vat_settlement_account_id` (`2250 VAT Payable (RRA)`, liability, plain; a net credit position sits as a debit on the same account — one account, one balance the accountant recognises), lines carrying the tax codes' `tax_code_id` with `tax_amount 0` so they are themselves *untagged movements* on the next return's tie and never counted as tax. Reversal only through the return (`module_reversal("tax")`, the P5 kernel rule); a return may not be filed over a range that overlaps a posted one (`vat_period_filed`). Annexes as CSV: sales (every fiscalized invoice and credit note with `custTin`, document number, `invc_no`, `rcpt_no`, `sdc_id`, date, base, VAT), purchases (every AP document with supplier TIN, reference, date, base, VAT, and the feed's `spplrInvcNo` when linked).

13. **Unrealized FX revaluation.** `FxRevalued` becomes the real event (module `gl`, doc type `FXR`, `FXR-` numbers, claimants `_ENTRY` + `fx_revaluations`). `fx_revaluations` (`number`, `revaluation_date`, `role` AR / AP or both, `journal_entry_id`, `reversal_entry_id` — the mirror, `status`) with `fx_revaluation_lines` (document, currency, `open_amount`, booking rate, carrying base = `open_amount × exchange_rate`, rate at the date from `exchange_rates`, revalued base, difference). Scope: **open foreign-currency partner documents** (AR and AP `open_amount ≠ 0`, `currency ≠ base`) at the revaluation date — not bank or cash accounts (out of scope, P8). Posting map, one entry per run: the gain or loss per (role, currency) to `4410 Unrealized FX Gain` / `6955 Unrealized FX Loss` (`gl_settings.unrealized_fx_gain_account_id` / `unrealized_fx_loss_account_id`), the other side to `1290 AR Revaluation` / `2190 AP Revaluation` (`gl_settings.ar_revaluation_account_id` / `ap_revaluation_account_id`, current asset / liability, plain) — **never the control accounts**, because `1200` / `2100` are subledger-only and their balance is Σ open items at booking rates (P4's invariant, still asserted after every row of the tape). Lines carry `partner_type/partner_id` so the report drills. The run posts the entry dated the revaluation date **and its mirror** dated the following day, in one transaction (the P2 frozen-base reversal, `reverses_entry_id` set) — the balance sheet at the date carries the revaluation, the next period does not, and realized FX at allocation stays P4's. Refused when the date's period is not open, when a run for that (role, date) already stands (`fx_revaluation_exists` — reverse it first), and when the date is not a period end (`fx_revaluation_not_period_end` — if the owner relaxes this later it is one line and a plan note, not a redesign). The run is a job kind on `run_job` (`fx_revaluation`) with a preview endpoint returning the lines without posting.

14. **Settings on the existing mechanism.** New `gl_settings` keys: `vat_settlement_account_id`, `ar_revaluation_account_id`, `ap_revaluation_account_id`, `unrealized_fx_gain_account_id`, `unrealized_fx_loss_account_id`, `fiscal_default_purchase_class_code`. Seed accounts `2250 VAT Payable (RRA)`, `1290 AR Revaluation`, `2190 AP Revaluation`, `4410 Unrealized Foreign Exchange Gain`, `6955 Unrealized Foreign Exchange Loss`; seed tax code `VAT-IN-IMP` "Input VAT 18% (Imports)" (input, 18 %, `1400`, `fiscal_tax_type B`); seed `fiscal_tax_type` on the four existing codes. Rwanda seed pack plus the back-fill migration for existing tenants, tested the P4–P6 way (`tests/test_p7_backfill.py`: provision at the pre-P7 revision with posted rows, upgrade, assert every key, account and code mapping lands non-null and nothing posted changed). The Defaults screen edits the six keys; no second settings store. The e2e seed gives Rugari Wines E2E an active `test` device on its main branch pointing at the sandbox (decision 16) and Kivu Traders none — one fiscalized company and one not, so every screen is exercised both ways.

15. **Permissions, numbering, idempotency, events.** New constants: `fiscal:setup_manage` (devices, codes sync, item classes, UoM and tax mappings), `fiscal:queue_manage` (retry / verify / attach / purchase feed / imports), `fiscal:reports_view` (queue, receipts, X/Z, the fiscal enquiries), `tax:vat_return_view`, `tax:vat_return_file`, `gl:fx_revalue`; back-fill Administrator. `DocType` entries `FIS`, `FIP`, `FSAR`, `FITM`, `FZR`, `VAT`, `FXR` with prefixes and claimants (decision 5, 12, 13). `Idempotency-Key` on device initialization, Z close, return filing, revaluation posting, feed accept/reject and import approve/reject (existing on every document post). Events: `VatReturnPosted` new; `FxRevalued` real; the `_StubEvent` comment block in `events.py` says so where the stub was, as P6 did for its three.

16. **The sandbox, and secrets.** `app/fiscal/rwanda/sandbox.py` — a FastAPI app implementing **both route profiles** of decision 1 against an in-memory ledger: initialization returns a fixed `sdcId SDC010000005` / `mrcNo WIS01006230` / keys and the `last*` counters; `saveSales` validates the header buckets against the items and `taxAmt` against `taxblAmt × r/(100+r)`, keeps per-type and total receipt counters, issues a deterministic 26-character `intrlData` and 16-character `rcptSign` (HMAC of the payload under the device's sign key, base32), refuses a duplicate `invcNo` with `994`, refuses a business `custTin` without `prcOrdCd` with `881` and an unknown TIN with `884`; the purchase feed, imports and code lists are fixtures; an admin endpoint `/_sandbox/mode` (never routed in production — `Settings.fiscal_sandbox_enabled`, refused at boot outside `dev`/`test` like the mail sink) switches `up | down | timeout | accept_then_timeout | reject:<code>` and `/_sandbox/ledger` exposes what it holds so a test can read the receipt it would have returned. Backend tests mount it in-process (`httpx.ASGITransport`); `docker-compose.e2e.yml` runs it as `ebm-sandbox` and the seed points the E2E device at it. **Keys:** Fernet under `Settings.fiscal_key_secret`; the three device keys are the only secrets, and the redaction test of decision 2 is the proof they stay that way.

## Build order — commit after each step with green checks

1. **Masters, settings, schema, the adapter skeleton, the sandbox.** `docs/rra/` pinned with `README.md`. Migration `0022_p7_fiscal`: `fiscal_devices`, `fiscal_codes` (code class + code + name + user-defined fields, per company), `fiscal_item_classes`, `fiscal_items`, `fiscal_outbox`, `fiscal_receipts`, `fiscal_daily_reports`, `fiscal_purchase_feed`, `fiscal_import_declarations`, `vat_returns`, `fx_revaluations` + `fx_revaluation_lines`; columns on `partner_documents` (`payment_method`, `purchase_code`, `refund_of_document_id`, `refund_reason`, `fiscal_receipt_id`), `items` (four), `uoms` (one), `tax_codes` (one); the six `gl_settings` keys; seed accounts and tax code; the back-fill with `tests/test_p7_backfill.py`; `DocType` entries, prefixes, claimants (with `numeric=True`); permissions; enums exported (drift gate green); `app/fiscal/` with the Protocol, `NullAdapter`, `codes.py`, `payloads.py` (every request/response of both documents as pydantic models, with one test per model round-tripping the document's own JSON sample), `routes.py` for both profiles, `mapping.py` DTOs, the sandbox app with its own tests; the device service (`initialize_device`, `activate`, `suspend`), codes and item-class sync with watermarks, TIN lookup; endpoints for devices/sync/lookup registered `GAP (P7, step 6)`. The census decision P6 handed over: read F-9.10 and the three step-9 runs, keep `max_examples` at the value the P6 PR set, move any floor that failed there into a targeted property that constructs its preconditions, and put the reach counters in the nightly job summary — in this step, so the phase does not inherit a red nightly. Migration applies from zero, `alembic check` clean, RLS linter green.

2. **Posting contract — the outbox in the posting transaction, item registration, sale and refund, receipts. STOP.** The hook in `post_document()` for a fiscalized company: the refusals of decisions 2, 3, 7 and 8 (`fiscal_device_missing`, `fiscal_item_required`, `purchase_code_required`, `refund_original_required`, `refund_spans_invoices`, `refund_exceeds_original`, `fiscal_class_missing`, `fiscal_uom_unmapped`, `tax_class_unmapped`) landing on the field they name; `invc_no` claimed and the `sale`/`refund` row inserted before `post_document` returns; `item` rows on first use and on change; the drainer with per-device FIFO, backoff under an injected clock, `unknown`, verify, attach, cancel-on-reversal (decision 7); `normalize_receipt()` for both profiles; `fiscal_receipts` written on `000`; `fiscal_requires_block`; the worker loop and the `drain` endpoint. `assert_fiscal_invariants`: document ↔ row 1:1; every `sent` sale/refund has exactly one receipt and no other status has one; `invc_no` gapless per device; `rcpt_no` strictly increasing per type and `tot_rcpt_no` across types per device; no row of a later `sequence_no` is `sent` while an earlier row of the same device is non-terminal; no key string in any stored payload or response. Hypothesis: random sequences of invoices (both tax modes, all four tax classes, discounts, both currencies, kits), credit notes against them, reversals, with the sandbox switched among `up | down | timeout | accept_then_timeout | reject` between operations, asserting ledger, subledger, stock, order and fiscal invariants after every step; the decision-6 property with its residue census at 0-dp and 2-dp. **STOP.** Report the schema, the payload map (kind × field × source column), the refusal table with the test that proves each sensitive, the invariant output, the residue census, and the two sandbox questions. Wait for approval before purchases and stock.

3. **Purchases, imports, stock reporting.** Decision 9 end to end (`purchase` on AP post, the feed with accept/reject and the no-double-registration rule, imports with approve/reject), decision 10 (`stock_io` + `stock_master` from the stock service on every posting, the `sarTyCd` table, between-branch transfers only, on-hand snapshot at enqueue), item deactivation re-registration; endpoints registered `GAP (P7, step 7)`. Tests: a GRN → sale → credit note → return to supplier → adjustment → cross-branch transfer sequence produces the stock rows in that order with the right `sarTyCd`s and masters that equal `stock_balances` summed per branch at each enqueue; the feed decision paths; an AP document linked to an accepted feed row is registered once.

4. **The VAT return, filing, X/Z, FX revaluation.** Decision 12: the query, the tie with untagged movements, late entries by high-water mark, `VatReturnPosted`, filing and reversal, annex CSVs; decision 11's X/Z computation and the Z close; decision 13: `FxRevalued` real, `fx_revaluations`, preview, post with the mirror, reversal, the three refusals. Tests with literals worked by hand: a month of postings whose return ties to `2200`/`1400` to the franc with one untagged payment listed; a late entry that changes the next return and not the filed one; a return that cannot overlap; a revaluation whose gain equals `open_amount × (rate_at − booking_rate)` per document, whose mirror nets to zero the next day, and after which `assert_subledger_invariants` still holds; a Z whose totals equal Σ of its receipts.

5. **Enquiries, listings, the acceptance tape — backend. STOP.** Queue listing per device with status counts, oldest queued age, `offline` flag, `last_success_at`; queue row detail with request/response (redacted) and the action log; receipts listing and search (by receipt number, document, customer, date); purchase-feed and import listings; VAT return listing; revaluation listing with lines; the item enquiry showing registration status and `item_cd`. Then the **acceptance tape** as a test in the RWF-base company against the in-process sandbox, expected values as literals worked by hand in a comment — never computed by the code under test. Setup: company `TIN 999000099`, `vat_registered`, device D00 on branch Main (`bhf_id 00`, profile `vsdc`, sandbox), items X (stock, `VAT-OUT-18`/B, 2 000 excl., cost 1 000), S (service, B, 10 000 excl.), E (stock, `VAT-EXEMPT`/A, 1 000, cost 500), Z (stock, `VAT-ZERO`/C, 5 000, cost 3 000), all with a class code and base UoM `U`; customer C (TIN `100000001`, phone, credit terms), walk-in W (no TIN), supplier S1 (TIN `100000002`); policy `block`; opening stock by GRN-1: X 100 @ 1 000, E 50 @ 500, Z 20 @ 3 000. Accounts: Sales 4100, VAT output 2200, VAT input 1400, AR 1200, AP 2100, Inventory 1300, COGS 5100, Accrual 2350, VAT settlement 2250, AR revaluation 1290, Unrealized gain 4410 / loss 6955.

   Row 5 said `drain at +0, +1 min, +5 min` and row 6 said `lastSaleInvcNo 5` ≥ 5 when this prompt was frozen; both corrected on the owner's direction at the step-5 gate — see the P7 step 5 row in `docs/approvals.md`. Row 5's three figures are the backoff *waits*, not offsets from the posting: the schedule is 1 → 5 → 15, so a row attempted at +0 is next due at +1 and one attempted at +1 is next due at +6, and a third drain at an absolute +5 finds nothing due — which contradicts the same row's own expected `attempts 3`. Row 6's counter is 6 because sales and refunds share the `FIS` run, as row 3's `invc_no 3` says and as row 6's own expected receipt `5/6 NS` says.

   After every row: `assert_ledger_invariants`, `assert_subledger_invariants`, `assert_stock_invariants`, `assert_order_invariants`, `assert_fiscal_invariants` green. Then the same tape's rows 0–3 under the `osdc` profile against the sandbox, proving the route table and `normalize_receipt()`. **The live run:** if the owner holds test-environment access (precondition d), run rows 0–3 against `https://sdcsandbox.rra.gov.rw` with the approved TIN/branch/serial and record the redacted transcript as `docs/rra/sandbox-run-<date>.md` with the two sandbox questions of decision 6 and the copy-counter question of decision 11 answered; if not, say so in the report — it is not a reason to wait. **STOP.** Report with the tape output table, the invariant output, the sandbox questions and their answers or their absence. Wait for approval before any UI work.

6. **Maintenance UI.** **EBM devices** (Maintenance → Tax, after Tax types: `/maintenance/ebm-devices`): list per branch with status, environment, profile, `sdc_id`, `mrc_no`, last success, offline flag; register (branch, profile, environment, base URL, device serial), Initialize, Suspend, Sync codes; keys never rendered. **Tax types** gains the EBM class column (A/B/C/D). **Units of measure** gains the RRA quantity-unit code (typeahead over the synced §4.6 list). **Items** gains a *Fiscal* section: class code typeahead over `fiscal_item_classes` (code + name), origin, packaging unit, item type, registration status and `item_cd`. **Customers** / **Suppliers** gain Verify TIN (the lookup's name and status shown beside the field). **Defaults** gains the six accounts and the default purchase class code. Clear the `GAP (P7, step 6)` lines; each screen opened by a test with data and a committed screenshot in `docs/screenshots/p7-step-6`.

7. **Transaction UI.** On **Invoice** and **Credit note**: payment method, purchase code (shown when the partner has a TIN, required on a fiscalized company — `purchase_code_required` inline), the credit note's *Refund of* picker (open fiscalized invoices of the partner) and reason code, the refusals of decision 8 inline on the item cell. On **Supplier invoice** and **Return to supplier**: payment method. **Document detail** (`/ar/documents/{id}`): the fiscal status chip (queued / sent with `rcptNo/totRcptNo NS` / failed with the code / unknown / needs receipt), the receipt block, Print gated, Copy print, and the queue actions of decision 4 on the document; the reversal dialog gains the refund reason on fiscalized invoices and shows `fiscal_refund_irreversible` before the button. **Fiscal queue** (Transactions → Tax: `/fiscal/queue`): per device, rows by status, Retry now / Verify with device / Attach receipt manually, the row's request and response, the action log. **EBM purchases** (`/fiscal/purchases`): the feed with Accept / Reject and the AP-document link. **Import declarations** (`/fiscal/imports`): the list with the item picker and Approve / Reject. **VAT return** (Transactions → Tax: `/tax/vat-return`): range picker, the return on screen with the tie and late entries, File, and the filed returns list with Reverse on detail. **FX revaluation** (Transactions → General Ledger, after Cashbook batches: `/gl/fx-revaluation`): date, role, Preview (the lines), Post, the runs list with Reverse. Appendix C: the owner's tree has Tax under Maintenance only — record the **Transactions → Tax** block (Fiscal queue, EBM purchases, Import declarations, VAT return) as C.1.10, the C.2 promise made good, and the FX revaluation row under Transactions → GL as C.1.11, both pinned in `appendix-c-order.test.tsx`. Clear the `GAP (P7, step 7)` lines; screenshots in `docs/screenshots/p7-step-7`.

8. **Enquiries and Reports UI.** **Enquiries → Tax:** Fiscal receipts (search, drill receipt → document → journal entry), Fiscal queue history (read-only, per document). **Reports → Tax:** VAT return (print layout and the two annex CSVs), Daily fiscal report — X (live) and Z (the closed days, with **Close day** on the X view under `fiscal:queue_manage`), Fiscal receipts listing (a range, per device, with the label, counters and totals — the accountant's tie between EBM and the sales ledger); **Reports → General Ledger:** FX revaluation (per run, the lines). Print preview and CSV as P3–P6; `sources.py` drill keys for every P7 source type so the GL entry page resolves `VATR-` and `FXR-` entries to their documents. Record Enquiries → Tax and Reports → Tax as the other half of C.1.10. Screenshots in `docs/screenshots/p7-step-8`.

9. **Tests, CI, phase close.** Playwright e2e on `docker compose` against a reset database with `ebm-sandbox` in the stack: the tape through the screens — initialize the device → register items → invoice with a purchase code → the queue shows it sent and the document prints with the SDC block (assert the receipt counter and one money figure read off the page, `pdftotext` on the print) → copy print → credit note with reason → sandbox down from the queue screen, Retry now fails, sandbox up, Retry now succeeds → the unknown row verified and attached → supplier invoice registered → feed accepted → Z closed and its totals read → VAT return ties and is filed → late entry appears next month → FX revaluation previewed, posted, reversed; the non-fiscalized company posts an invoice with no queue row and prints the P4 layout. Sensitivity pass on the final SHA, one guard at a time, naming the test that catches each: same-transaction enqueue, per-device ordering, `fiscal_requires_block`, `purchase_code_required`, `refund_exceeds_original`, the immutability of `fiscal_receipts` and `vat_returns`, the high-water rule, the revaluation never touching a control account, key redaction. Register: the four inherited lines plus `POST /fiscal/outbox/drain` (`by design`), nothing else. `docs/rra/certification.md`: the runbook — what RRA's certification email needs (business registration, RSSB and tax clearance, product brochure and warranty statement, physical address, user manual, installation guide, programming/configuration manual, software support SLA — the list on RRA's "how to acquire EBM" page, re-checked at step 9), the MRC scheme (`BBBCCNNNNNN`: developer id + certificate number + serial) and where Vinea stores each part, the test-environment steps, the checkpoint-sheet mapping (each checkpoint → the screen or test that shows it), and the open questions. README → Phase 7 complete, `docs/p7-final-report.md` (what landed, decisions worth review, plan deviations with reasons — the route-profile reading, the VAT filing entry, the purchase-registration rule and anything the sandbox questions changed), approvals rows in `docs/approvals.md`, Appendix C updated for the new Tax blocks and the FX row, the Master Plan's "P7 as built" section in the form of P6's, screenshots in `docs/screenshots/p7-step-9`.

## Definition of Done (all must be true)

The acceptance tape reproduces every expected value above to the rounding rule; `assert_fiscal_invariants` passes, so every posted invoice and credit note on a fiscalized company has exactly one outbox row and every sent one exactly one receipt, `invc_no` is gapless per device and the receipt counters strictly increase; a queued invoice survives the sandbox being down through three backoff steps and completes when it returns, in order, with the stock report behind it; a response that never arrived is resolved by verification and manual attachment, never by a blind resend; the receipt prints in the CIS layout with the SDC block and QR, refuses to print before the receipt exists, and reprints as a COPY; a fiscalized company cannot sell what it does not hold and cannot invoice a TIN without a purchase code; the VAT return ties to the VAT accounts with every untagged movement listed, a filed return never changes and a late entry lands in the next one; the settlement entry posts through the kernel and reverses only through the return; the FX revaluation moves the revaluation accounts and never the control accounts, and its mirror nets it out the next day; nothing outside `app/fiscal/` knows an RRA field name; no device key is readable through any endpoint or present in any stored payload; every P7 row — EBM devices, the four Transactions → Tax screens, FX revaluation, the two Tax enquiries, the four Tax reports and the FX report — is live, untagged, opened by a test with data and shown in a committed screenshot; the tape runs under both route profiles against the sandbox; the live run against `sdcsandbox.rra.gov.rw` is recorded, **or** the phase closes *code-complete, certification pending* with `docs/rra/certification.md` written and the deviation named in the final report; nothing writes to the ledger outside the PostingEngine; every audited call passes a real actor; every mutating endpoint has a caller or the one `by design` line; CI green on backend and frontend. Final report: what landed, screenshots of a fiscalized invoice printed with its SDC block, the queue with a blocked device and its recovery, the VAT return with its tie, the Z report, and the revaluation preview; decisions worth review; the answers to the sandbox questions or the fact that they are still open; and any plan deviations with reasons.
